title: Maharashtra 2026–27 agriculture CAP rounds concluded with college-level admissions in September 2026
description: Review the sourced 2026–27 Maharashtra agriculture CAP calendar (July–September 2026) recorded for Shri Shivaji Agriculture College, Amravati.
summary: The 2026–27 Maharashtra state agriculture admission calendar opened online registration on 10 July 2026, released first CAP allotments on 16 August 2026, and completed college-level spot rounds between 13 and 17 September 2026.

sections.heading: The 2026–27 Maharashtra CAP timeline on record
paragraphs: For Maharashtra’s Centralized Admission Process (CAP) governing affiliated agriculture colleges such as [Shri Shivaji Agriculture College, Amravati](/university/shri-shivaji-agriculture-college) (affiliated to Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth, Akola), the 2026–27 state calendar opened online registration on 10 July 2026 with an application deadline of 2 August 2026.

The first CAP allotment was published on 16 August 2026, followed by subsequent rounds and the college-level admission round from 13 September to 17 September 2026, with 17 September 2026 recorded as the final admission cutoff date for the cycle.

sections.heading: Why a final admission cutoff date is not a closing score
paragraphs: Applicants reading archived CAP schedules should note that "17 September 2026 final admission cutoff" refers to the administrative deadline for completing admissions, not a MHT-CET percentile or rank threshold. Read [prepare for agriculture admission counselling](/blogs/prepare-for-agriculture-counselling) to see how state CAP rounds transition to college-level spot rounds.

faqs.question: Which university affiliates Shri Shivaji Agriculture College, Amravati?
faqs.answer: It is affiliated with Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth (Dr. PDKV), Akola in Maharashtra.

faqs.question: Were college-level admissions open after 17 September 2026 in the recorded schedule?
faqs.answer: No. The 2026–27 schedule recorded 13–17 September 2026 for the college-level round and 17 September 2026 as the final admission cutoff date.

verification_notes: All five 2026–27 CAP milestone dates are taken directly from the audited Shri Shivaji Agriculture College profile.
